author: Cathy Norris
text:
Don’t recommend. They messed up my property and it’s going to cost too much to fix it. They were supposed to do 2 mobile home pads, driveways and clearing. They did the minimum amount of work for maximum price and didn’t do it correctly. Both pads were not big enough, he buried the top soil, my pad was facing the wrong direction and was not leveled. He basically made my pad into a pond. He placed my driveway in the wrong spot and to the opposite end of the house. Who wants their driveway to the master bedroom instead of to the carport? The other pad wasn’t crowned and holding water too.  They kept working after I told them to stop and to hold off until we were on the same page. They said they couldn’t stop and then collected the money from the mobile home company that same day from the loan I don’t even have. They didn’t return my messages or calls for over a week.

Update since they replied: yes we met each day beforehand and the work was worse each day, then left in a mess and didn’t respond to my calls or messages for over a week. How did you go above and beyond? Our property is ruined and can’t ever get it back to what it was.

author: Ginger Gilmore
text: They came to see what the issue was and my 136 pound dog could not walk. They carried her from my basement to the car so I could take her to the vet. Did an excellent job replacing the field lines, also. Thank you, thank you! Great job! Definitely recommend this company.

author: T Lawley
text: These guys came out and repaired my septic system after another company tried up selling to all new field lines to the tune of $4k+. They looked at our system and after giving them the go ahead came out and repaired the very next day. No need to replace field lines. We’re very appreciative of their honesty and prompt response to our inquiry. Thanks guys!

author: Kim Eriksson
text: Pickle did an amazing job for us. We called about a problem with our septic tank. They came out within 2 hours, and did a great job! Another company was going to charge us more and were going to take another day to come out.

author: Peter Wright
text: Mr Pickle came out when he said he would and banged out our new septic install. Very professional and quality team from his wife in the office to his helpers!  Some small damage occurred when he was digging a massive rock out of the septic hole and he came out immediately to repair and make the neighbors happy.  Highly recommend!
